title: Gemini Robotics 2 Brings Whole-Body Intelligence to Robots
summary: Google DeepMind released Gemini Robotics 2 on July 30, 2026 as a family of three models: a vision-language-action model for full humanoids and bi-arm robots, Gemini Robotics ER 2 for embodied reasoning and multi-robot teamwork, and an on-device VLA that adapts to a new robot body in hours from under 200 examples. The system covers whole-body control — walking, crouching, reaching — plus five-fingered manipulation at 22 degrees of freedom and multi-step tasks lasting minutes. Reported results include 45.7-76.3% success on general whole-body manipulation and 74.2-89.6% on gripper pick-place and insertion. Demonstrations span Apptronik's Apollo 2, Franka Duo, Boston Dynamics and Agile Robots platforms.
whyItMatters: Previous robot foundation models stopped at the table edge: an arm, a gripper, a fixed base. Gemini Robotics 2 puts locomotion, five-finger dexterity and multi-robot coordination behind one reasoning stack, so balance and manipulation are planned together rather than by separate controllers. The on-device variant matters just as much — cross-embodiment transfer in hours with a couple of hundred examples is what makes a foundation model deployable on hardware it never saw in training.
